parts.request: complete ordinary request, or correction-v1 with recoveryOf:{verifiedOriginalId} and immutable correction:{clientImportId,idempotencyKey,payloadHash,createdAt,items}

coverageShapes.desiredItem: exact ordinary business intent row, including omission versus explicit null

planDocument.coverageRules: all original clientItemIds exactly once; all child rows exactly once; original_accepted only correction; contributors require exact immutable request intent and complete durable ACK, never current prices or NoChange
planDocument.supersedesRules: All predecessor unACKed children need exact authoritative retired fences; all prior accepted parts and contributions must carry complete durable immutable proof. Same root/shop/device/mode. One initial plan per root identity/canonical hash and one successor per predecessor. Old partial plan is immutable. Maximum 128 generations.

identityRules.replacement: coverage.clientItemId is immutable original/root ID; childClientItemId explicitly selects a row in the new child and can differ. Exact root coverage plus one-to-one child membership required. Corrected barcode/metadata are permitted by ordinary validation and current catalog.import.
identityRules.correction: existing correction item IDs and authoritative product mapping remain linked to original receipt root; no new field semantics.
identityRules.acceptedPlanPart: contributorClientItemId is actual immutable accepted ancestor CHILD ID. Server resolves original root ID from stored ancestor coverage; IDs need not be equal. Full ACK/status/hash/mapping proof mandatory; skipped own-row membership has null product and cannot prove economics.

hashSemantics.rawSha256: sha256:<64 lowercase hex> over exact UTF-8 bytes; independent of client business declaration
hashSemantics.payloadHash: opaque bounded historic client declaration; never trusted as canonical proof
hashSemantics.canonicalPayloadHash: server rederives existing ordinary/correction business canonical SHA256 from complete original
hashSemantics.manifestSha256: SHA256 JSON.stringify normalized full manifest including originalKind and declaredPayloadHash for original uploads, server determined
hashSemantics.planCanonicalHash: SHA256 JSON.stringify complete server-normalized plan and all bound proof coverage
hashSemantics.receiptSha256: Server page identity SHA256 of persisted PostgreSQL jsonb::text full ACK; same on all pages; client verifies stable identity and complete coverage, not PostgreSQL serialization; live snapshots excluded

safety.unsafeJsonInteger: explicit fail, exact decimal text preserved within existing forensic limits
safety.scope: current authorized shop/device/owner catalog.import on each transaction and after wait
safety.neverSentOffline: local ordinary parts, no recovery network or retirement required
safety.acceptedPageSummary: original full immutable ACK counts, not page counts
safety.planPartReceiptRetireSelector: XOR verifiedOriginalId OR planId+partIndex; part identity and original resolved from private immutable plan
safety.acceptedPageComplete: true iff offset+limit>=totalItemCount; client still proves full contiguous coverage, not one page

persistedOriginalFormats.ordinary: exact saved PayloadJson; payloadHash and attemptCount may be omitted; declaration separate upload metadata
persistedOriginalFormats.correction: exact request OR saved {originalReceipt,request}; only request parsed; saved receipt never authoritative
persistedOriginalFormats.declaredPayloadHash: required mode original; present raw identity declaration must match; root recoveryOf.payloadHash distinct from child declaration

boundedPhases.planManifestRoot: Phased plan manifests require verifiedOriginalId. The server derives the same logical ordinary root and staging claim; future credits are spent only after complete valid plan proof.
boundedPhases.legacyLimitsScope: The limits block below describes the historic full-manifest parser shape. Current compatibility admission permits raw<=4MiB, or returns phased_upload_required. The new phased candidate overrides aggregate raw/chunks/logical children with512MiB/2048/1024 and retains HTTP512KiB/ordinary1000.

childResponses.accepted: First receipt/retire child page contains its complete <=1000-row ACK, fully validated in DB; do not assume receipt-page works until private part ACK exists. Explicit retire adopts an externally committed exact child ACK into its missing private part ACK with no economic replay. Receipt does not adopt/write.
childResponses.retired: oldIdentityBlocked=true and retiredAt server UTC. This fences this child only and does not complete/retire the whole plan.
childResponses.paging: First child receipt/retire page is complete because child<=1000. Separate receipt-page requires private part ACK, obtained by ordinary B apply or explicit retire accepted adoption if external standard apply won. It returns conflict part_not_accepted without that adoption. Stable receipt hash/summary and complete range checks remain required.
childResponses.unknownPlanOrPart: HTTP404 failure no identity binding can be asserted; known-child conflicts may report reason and binding per source gate
childResponses.stalePreparedPlan: Re-register exact same saved upload/plan bytes and same IDs after lost response, then explicitly retire every unaccepted staged child (ACK wins => carry), then immutable successor supersedes. Never rewrite prepared bytes/intent or infer the group completed from one part.

actionMetadata.missingFieldRule: Absent metadata is null in client acquisition records; no parent inference.

childResponses.lostRetirementResponseRule: See ../child-retirement-lost-response/wire.rule.json and its captured immutable raw frames. Conflict/identity_retired is not a retired proof; retry the same explicit retire selector to obtain persisted timestamp and oldIdentityBlocked.

phased_upload_required.retry: Same immutable raw bytes and upload identity through root-bound phases; no saved intent rewrite.
